description: Integrate all new modules into orchestrator, __main__.py CLI, and __init__.py exports. Add CLI flags and wire up the attack pipeline.
steps: 1. Update posframework/orchestrator.py - Import all new modules. Add constructor parameters: enable_ap_clone=False, enable_krack=False, enable_dos=False, dos_mode=None, enable_client_isolation=False, enable_printer_attacks=False. In start() after existing Phase 5c, add Phase 5d (Advanced WiFi attacks) and Phase 5e (Printer attacks). In stop(), add all new engines to the engines list. Wire up APCloneEngine to activate after deauth phase. Wire up KRACKEngine when handshake is captured. Wire up WiFiDoSEngine as alternative/supplement to deauth. Wire up ClientIsolationEngine alongside deauth. Wire up PrinterRecon, PrintJobInterceptor, PrinterCredentialHarvester in printer phase.

2. Update posframework/__main__.py - Add CLI arguments to 'attack' and 'full' subparsers: --enable-ap-clone, --enable-krack, --enable-dos, --dos-mode (choices: cts_flood, beacon_exhaust, qos_null, fragment), --enable-client-isolation, --enable-printer-attacks. Pass these to AttackOrchestrator constructor.

3. Update posframework/__init__.py - Add imports for all new modules so they are accessible from the package. Add: from .ap_clone import APCloneEngine; from .krack import KRACKEngine; from .dos_wifi import WiFiDoSEngine; from .client_isolation import ClientIsolationEngine; from .printer_recon import PrinterRecon; from .ipp_scanner import IPPScanner; from .print_interceptor import PrintJobInterceptor; from .printer_creds import PrinterCredentialHarvester.

4. Update posframework/config.py - Add new configuration constants: KRACK_REPLAY_COUNT=3, DOS_CTS_INTERVAL=0.01, DOS_BEACON_INTERVAL=0.005, DOS_QOS_INTERVAL=0.02, PRINTER_SCAN_TIMEOUT=30, IPP_DEFAULT_PORT=631, SNMP_DEFAULT_PORT=161, PRINTER_SNMP_COMMUNITY='public'.
